The Artist

Bringing Lines
to Life

Arav creates pencil artwork guided by a deep appreciation for light, shadow, and texture. Each piece is built layer by layer — from the first light construction lines to the final deep graphite shadows that give the drawing its soul.

From hyper-realistic portrait commissions capturing every strand of hair and jewel, to dynamic anime characters radiating personality — every drawing is a meditation in patience and craft.

What You Get

Every sketch is handcrafted just for you

All commissions are drawn by hand using professional graphite and charcoal pencils on quality sketch paper. You receive a high-resolution scan and the physical artwork.

  • Original physical sketch on quality paper
  • High-resolution digital scan included
  • Progress updates during creation
  • Clear reference photo required
  • Delivery: 7–14 working days
  • DM on Instagram to begin order

Behind the Art

Artistic Process

I
Basic Outline

Light construction lines establish composition and positioning.

II
Face Proportions

Careful measurement and placement of all facial features.

III
Soft Shading

Initial light shading builds tone and three-dimensional form.

IV
Blending

Tortillon blending creates seamless gradients and soft shadows.

V
Hair & Eyes

Fine sharp marks render hair strands, lashes, and eye reflections.

VI
Final Shading

Deep graphite darkens shadows and finalizes the full drawing.
